verses.1: And God blessed Noah and his sons. He said to them, “Procreate and multiply, and fill the earth.”
verses.2: And your tools and weapons will be used to destroy every living creature on earth, and every corner of the sky. They will be given to you for use in all that you may cultivate the land, and in all the creatures of the sea.
verses.3: All the plants that he has given you will be food for you, just like grass from the fields. I have given you all these plants.
verses.4: But in his heart, his blood cannot be consumed.
verses.5: But your own souls are unacceptable to you. Every living being rejects them. And from the hand of man, from the hand of any person or brother, the soul of man is rejected.
verses.6: Man’s blood is spilled upon man; his blood is shed because, in the image of God, man was created.
verses.7: And you also multiplied and grew in number on this land. You became numerous there.
verses.8: And God said to Noah and to his sons, “Behold, I have sent upon you a flood.”
verses.9: And I will make a covenant with you, and with your descendants as well.
verses.10: And every living being that is in the birds and all the animals of the earth, they all come from the dust of the earth.
verses.11: And I have made a covenant with you. No one will be able to destroy anything that still remains from the flood. There will no longer be any floods to destroy the land.
verses.12: And God said this as a covenant between me and you, and between all living beings among you, for eternity.
verses.13: I have placed my covenant in the clouds. Thus, a covenant shall be established between me and the earth.
verses.14: And there will be a cloud over the earth, and darkness will cover the land.
verses.15: And I remember my covenant with you, and with all living things. No more will there be floods that destroy all living beings.
verses.16: And the cloud shall be like a memory of a eternal covenant between God and every living being on earth.
verses.17: And God said to Noah, “This is the covenant I have made between me and every living creature on the earth.”
verses.18: And the sons of Noah, who came out of the ark, were beautiful and handsome. And Ham was their father.
verses.19: These are the three sons of Noah. From them, all the earth was filled with life.
verses.20: And Noah became a man of the land, and he planted his vineyard.
verses.21: And he was born from the womb; he was sold and found in the midst of the tent.
verses.22: And Haman saw the evil deeds of his father, and he reported them to his two brothers.
verses.23: And he took the beautiful cloak, and they both put it on themselves. Then they went away, one behind the other. They covered the shame of their ancestors with that cloak. They did not see the shame of their ancestors at all.
verses.24: And Noah remembered what his little son had done for him.
verses.25: And Aruur said, “In Canaan, there will be servants who will serve their brothers.”
verses.26: And the Lord blessed him, saying, “May Kenaan be a servant to me.”
verses.27: May God be beautiful, and may He dwell in His temples. And let him be like a servant to Him.
verses.28: And Noah lived after the flood for three hundred years, and then another fifty years.
verses.29: And during all the days of Noah’s life, there were forty years and fifty years. Then he died.
